description: Rothco’s Enhanced Canvas Duffle Bag is designed to carry all your essential gear, no matter where your journey takes you. With a 75 liter capacity and measuring 32 inches x 12 inches x 12 inches, this duffle bag offers ample storage space for all your belongings. Its heavy-duty, unwashed canvas construction ensures durability and longevity, while the reinforced stitching provides extra strength for heavy loads. The bag features adjustable 0.25 inch padded backpack-style shoulder straps for easy and comfortable transport, along with dual side carry handles and 2 top carry handles with a wrap-around strap for versatile carrying options. 4 compression cinch straps with quick-release buckles allow you to adjust the bag's size for optimal weight distribution and balance. The full-length zipper closure with a flap cover ensures easy access to your supplies, and the center metal locking loop allows you to secure your contents with a padlock. Additionally, a hook and loop identification window and hidden document pocket provide convenient storage for important paperwork and travel documents. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
